title.value: NL-PS-L4-A - Level 4a: Two minimal GBBs per section - Patient id

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 4a test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least two entries that refer to generic building blocks (GBBs) in the document, and has a narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 4a test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
Patient.id of your level 4a test patient, without 'Patient/'.
Search the NL-PS Composition of the test patient with the Patient id entered at test setup.
